## Two Double Bedroom Split-Level Flat to Rent – Tooting Broadway, London
£2,000 pcm

A well-presented split-level two double bedroom, two bathroom flat ideally positioned in the vibrant and well-connected area of Tooting Broadway. Offering generous accommodation arranged over two floors, this appealing home is well suited to professional sharers, couples or a small family seeking space, convenience and access to excellent local amenities.

The property benefits from a practical split-level layout, creating a clear separation between living and sleeping areas. The spacious reception room provides an inviting setting for relaxing, entertaining or working from home, with room for comfortable seating and a dining area. The kitchen is conveniently arranged for everyday use, with space for food preparation and storage.

Both bedrooms are genuine doubles, providing flexible accommodation for sharers, guest rooms, home offices or additional storage. The flat further benefits from two bathrooms, offering welcome privacy and convenience for busy households.

Located close to Tooting Broadway Underground Station on the Northern line, the property offers straightforward links towards Central London, including London Bridge, Bank, Waterloo and the City. The surrounding area is packed with independent cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, gyms and local shops, while Tooting’s much-loved indoor markets and green spaces are also within easy reach.

### Key Features
- Split-level flat
- Two well-proportioned double bedrooms
- Two bathrooms
- Spacious living accommodation
- Ideal for professional sharers, a couple or a small family
- Excellent access to Tooting Broadway Underground Station
- Close to shops, restaurants, cafés and local amenities
- Available to rent at £2,000 per calendar month

---

## Things to Do in Tooting Broadway, London

Tooting Broadway is one of South London’s most lively and characterful neighbourhoods, known for its outstanding food scene, multicultural atmosphere, convenient transport connections and easy access to green space. Whether you enjoy dining out, discovering independent businesses, keeping active or spending time outdoors, there is plenty to explore locally.

### Explore Tooting Market
Tooting Market is at the heart of the neighbourhood and is a must-visit for food lovers. This covered market brings together a wide range of independent traders, street-food kitchens, bars, cafés and specialist shops. It is particularly popular for its diverse international food offering, with cuisines from around the world represented in one vibrant setting.

The market is a great destination for a casual lunch, evening meal or weekend catch-up with friends. Alongside food stalls, visitors can browse independent retailers and enjoy the energetic community feel that makes Tooting such a distinctive part of London.

### Visit Broadway Market
Close to Tooting Broadway station, Broadway Market is another local favourite. It offers an excellent mix of fresh produce, butchers, fishmongers, bakeries, cafés and independent food outlets. It is ideal for picking up ingredients for a home-cooked meal, sampling local food or enjoying a relaxed coffee while taking in the buzz of the area.

### Discover Tooting’s Restaurant Scene
Tooting is widely regarded as one of London’s best areas for South Asian food, with an impressive choice of Indian, Pakistani, Sri Lankan, Nepalese and Bangladeshi restaurants. Long-established local favourites sit alongside modern eateries and informal street-food venues, making the area particularly appealing for anyone who enjoys trying new flavours.

There are also plenty of options for brunch, pizza, burgers, vegan food, desserts and casual drinks. The variety means there is something to suit almost every occasion, from a quick midweek dinner to a relaxed weekend meal.

### Relax at Tooting Common
A short distance from Tooting Broadway, Tooting Common provides a welcome escape from city life. The common is made up of two expansive open spaces—Tooting Bec Common and Tooting Graveney Common—and is ideal for walking, jogging, cycling, picnics and outdoor exercise.

The area offers wide grassy spaces, woodland walks, tennis courts and playgrounds, making it popular with runners, dog walkers, families and anyone looking to enjoy some fresh air. During warmer months, it is a particularly pleasant place to spend an afternoon outdoors.

### Swim at Tooting Bec Lido
Situated near Tooting Common, Tooting Bec Lido is one of London’s best-known outdoor swimming pools. It is famed for being one of the largest open-air freshwater lidos in the UK and is a fantastic local amenity for swimming enthusiasts. The lido is especially popular in spring and summer, although its regular swimming sessions make it an attractive destination for active residents throughout much of the year.

### Enjoy Local Pubs, Bars and Cafés
Tooting Broadway has a relaxed but sociable nightlife scene, with traditional pubs, cocktail bars, independent cafés and casual drinking spots nearby. Whether you are looking for a quiet pint, live sport, a Sunday roast or an evening out with friends, the local area offers a good choice of venues.

The neighbourhood’s café culture is also growing, with plenty of places to enjoy a weekend brunch, speciality coffee or a casual lunch.

### Keep Active Locally
The area has a range of gyms, fitness studios and leisure facilities, with options for yoga, Pilates, group training and traditional gym sessions. Tooting Common is also a popular setting for outdoor running and fitness, while nearby leisure centres provide further opportunities for swimming and organised sport.

### Easy Access to Central London and Beyond
One of Tooting Broadway’s biggest advantages is its transport connectivity. Tooting Broadway Underground Station, on the Northern line, provides direct routes into Central London and the City. This makes it easy to reach areas such as Clapham, Balham, Waterloo, London Bridge, Bank and Moorgate.

Nearby rail stations and bus routes also provide convenient links across South London, including Wimbledon, Streatham, Clapham Junction and Brixton. This combination of local character and city-wide accessibility makes Tooting Broadway an increasingly popular choice for renters.
